headline: Kettles click in stacked flats.
body: A window two floors up is already steamed. The delivery van waits at the corner as if the street still belongs to last night. We keep the radio low; the news can wait for the first cup.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: thin high cloud, pale east, no heat

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: wet at the kerb, dry in the middle

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: 07:32 BST, schoolbags not yet on the step
